chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
There was a female servant for Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) who would slaughter [an animal] for him whenever he wished.
ai.seo_question: Who was the female servant of Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn and what was her role?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* illustrates the practical domestic life of Imam Zayn al-Abidin, noting that his female servant (*jariya*) performed the slaughter of animals for him. In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as a key evidence for the permissibility of the Imam delegating the act of slaughter to a servant, thereby validating the servant's slaughtering as sufficient for the Imam's consumption, provided the servant is competent and the conditions of *dhabh* are met.
